title: Planck-conditioned base ΛCDM

source_evidence.locator: HTML S2.SS1 (Sec2.1): six sampled parameters, adiabatic power law, 0.05 Mpc^-1 pivot, one 0.06 eV plus two massless neutrinos, BBN PArthENoPE1.1/neutron880.2s; HTML S3.T1 caption: Plik marginalized means versus best fit, massive neutrino included in Omega_m, theta_MC versus theta_star; HTML S3.SS1 footnote14: T_CMB2.7255K; PDF p16 Table2: all eleven registered values/errors and TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing column; no BAO; tanh reionization and BBN helium caption; HTML S7.SS5.SSS2: standard Neff3.046 text; Eq62 read but not used

assumptions: Spatially flat GR with photons, baryons/CDM, one fixed massive neutrino and standard thermal/primordial/reionization closure.
Six sampled parameters differ from H0, Omega_m and drag quantities derived by the conditioned fit.
predictions: The specified model and baseline likelihood yield source-reported marginal parameter constraints; they are not independent measurements.
Massive-neutrino transition and predicted ionization/drag/perturbation closure are required for faithful model comparison.
